command: mkdir -p "$HOME/Projects/walk-company" && ls -d "$HOME/Projects/walk-company" && ls -d "$HOME/Applications/ChatGPT.app" /Applications/ChatGPT.app 2>&1; command -v codex || echo 'no codex on PATH'
osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "g" using {command down, shift down}'

osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to key code 36'

command: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to key code 53'

d="$HOME/Applications/ChatGPT.app/Contents/Resources/codex-cli/CodexCLI.app/Contents/MacOS" && mkdir -p "$d" && printf '#!/bin/sh
# A stand-in for the Codex CLI, for this walk only: it answers login status as a signed-in codex-cli 0.162.0-alpha.2 does, and nothing else.
if [ "$1 $2" = "login status" ]; then echo "Logged in using ChatGPT" >&2; exit 0; fi
exit 1
' > "$d/codex" && chmod +x "$d/codex" && "$d/codex" login status; echo "exit $?"
osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to key code 53'
